name: TaxID VAT Validation API
description: REST/JSON validation of VAT and tax identification numbers — all 27 EU member states via VIES, plus the United Kingdom, Australia and Norway. Wraps the EU VIES SOAP service with caching, local format pre-checks, and a distinct status for registry downtime so an outage never reads as an invalid number. Countries without a reachable registry are validated by format and checksum.
